verdict.rationale: Khoj is a self-hostable assistant server, so a documented public API is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents one: the docs cover the Emacs, Obsidian, desktop, web and WhatsApp clients plus the admin panel, but no API reference. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404. Multiple clients suggest an internal server API exists, but nothing shows it is documented for public use, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
